evals.name: Decision-log classifications remain traceable
evals.prompt: Generate fit-gap analysis from the supplied Live decision log.
evals.expected_output: One FIT, one GAP routed to solution-design-required, and one unresolved WORKAROUND. Every result cites its original FTS Row ID.

assertions.name: all_row_ids_retained
assertions.description: Every input FTS Row ID appears once in the analysis.

assertions.name: no_tier_inference
assertions.description: The Gap disposition is solution-design-required, not a technical tier.

assertions.name: workaround_remains_open
assertions.description: Unresolved Workaround is open-question, not silently classified as Fit or Gap.
